FisicaBitSerial.leerSensorInterno|block: Reads an internal micro:bit sensor and returns its value.
FisicaBitSerial.leerSensorAnalogico|bloc: Reads an analog sensor connected to a pin (0-1023).
FisicaBitSerial.enviar1|block: Sends the micro:bit time (ms) and one measured value to fisicabit.com over USB, then waits until the next sample. Place inside "forever". Line sent: time,value. Example: acceleration x every 100 ms = 10 samples per second.
FisicaBitSerial.enviar1|param|valor: Value to send (sensor, variable or calculation)
FisicaBitSerial.enviar2|block: Sends the micro:bit time and two measured values to fisicabit.com over USB, then waits until the next sample. Line: time,value1,value2.
FisicaBitSerial.enviar3|block: Sends the micro:bit time and three measured values to fisicabit.com over USB, then waits until the next sample. Line: time,value1,value2,value3.
FisicaBitSerial.enviar4|block: Deprecated: fisicabit.com supports up to 3 variables and discards 4-value lines; use the 3-value block. Sends the micro:bit time and four measured values to fisicabit.com over USB, then waits until the next sample.
FisicaBitSerial.bucleMuestreo|block: Fast loop for fisicabit.com: runs the inner code every X ms with precise timing, without the hidden delay of "forever". Use instead of "forever" for 50-100 Hz. Put the send block inside; its "every ... ms" is ignored inside the loop.
FisicaBitSerial.bucleMuestreo|param|cuer: Code to run on each sample
FisicaBitSerial.tiempoSerial|block: Time in milliseconds since USB streaming started (starts at 0).
FisicaBitSerial.enviarTimestamp|block: Enables or disables sending the micro:bit time as the first column. Must match the "Micro:bit sends timestamp" option on fisicabit.com.
FisicaBitSerial.enviarTimestamp|param|ac: true = send time (default), false = values only
FisicaBitSerial.fijarDecimales|block: Number of decimals used for non-integer values.
FisicaBitSerial.enviarLinea|block: Sends a free text line over USB.
FisicaBitSerial.enviar1|param|ms: Time between samples in ms (100 = 10 per second), eg: 100
FisicaBitSerial.enviar2|param|ms: Time between samples in ms, eg: 100
FisicaBitSerial.enviar3|param|ms: Time between samples in ms, eg: 100
FisicaBitSerial.enviar4|param|ms: Time between samples in ms, eg: 100
FisicaBitSerial.bucleMuestreo|param|ms: Time between samples in ms, eg: 50
FisicaBitSerial.enviarSinTiempo1|block: Sends only one measured value to fisicabit.com over USB, without the micro:bit time and without waiting: it is sent the moment the block runs. Use it on a button press or inside "forever" with your own pause. On fisicabit.com: "Micro:bit sends timestamp" disabled.
FisicaBitSerial.enviarSinTiempo2|block: Sends only two measured values to fisicabit.com over USB, without the micro:bit time and without waiting: it is sent the moment the block runs. Use it on a button press or inside "forever" with your own pause. On fisicabit.com: "Micro:bit sends timestamp" disabled.
FisicaBitSerial.enviarSinTiempo3|block: Sends only three measured values to fisicabit.com over USB, without the micro:bit time and without waiting: it is sent the moment the block runs. Use it on a button press or inside "forever" with your own pause. On fisicabit.com: "Micro:bit sends timestamp" disabled.
FisicaBitSerial.enviarSinTiempo4|block: Deprecated: fisicabit.com supports up to 3 variables and discards 4-value lines; use the 3-value block. Sends only four measured values to fisicabit.com over USB, without the micro:bit time and without waiting: it is sent the moment the block runs. Use it on a button press or inside "forever" with your own pause. On fisicabit.com: "Micro:bit sends timestamp" disabled.
FisicaBitSerial.medirDistanciaUltrasonid: Distance measured with an HC-SR04 (2 to 400 cm). It initializes itself: a 10 µs pulse on TRIG, the echo is timed and the distance comes from the time of flight with the temperature-corrected speed of sound. Returns the latest filtered measurement (sliding median); if the echo fails, the last valid value. Never triggers faster than the module cycle (30 ms). Wiring: VCC → 3V, GND → GND, TRIG → P8, ECHO → P12 (the simulator shows it). With 5 V on VCC, 1 kΩ / 2 kΩ divider on ECHO.
Unit: cm (1 decimal), mm, inches or m (3 decimals)
FisicaBitSerial.medirDistanciaSRF05: Distance measured with an HY-SRF05. With OUT floating (4-wire mode) it is wired like the HC-SR04: VCC → 3V, GND → GND, TRIG → P8, ECHO → P12. Single-wire mode (OUT to GND): use the SAME pin for TRIG and ECHO. Everything else works like the HC-SR04 block.
FisicaBitSerial.medirDistanciaSRF05|para: Unit: cm (1 decimal), mm, inches or m (3 decimals)
FisicaBitSerial.enviarDistanciaUltrasoni: Sends to fisicabit.com over USB every HC-SR04 echo with the real instant at which the sound hit the object: one "time,distance" line per sample, at the sensor rate (≈33 Hz). Skips samples without echo instead of repeating stale values. Put it inside "forever"; no "every ... ms" is needed. On fisicabit.com: 1 variable, "Micro:bit sends timestamp" enabled.
Unit: cm (1 decimal), mm, inches or m (3 decimals)
FisicaBitSerial.enviarDistanciaSRF05: Sends to fisicabit.com over USB every HY-SRF05 echo with the real instant at which the sound hit the object (one line per sample, at the sensor rate). Single-wire mode: the same pin for TRIG and ECHO.
FisicaBitSerial.enviarDistanciaSRF05|par: Unit: cm (1 decimal), mm, inches or m (3 decimals)
FisicaBitSerial.fijarAlcanceUltrasonido: Maximum range you want to measure. It defines how long to wait for the echo (and, at long range, the sample rate). For a cart on a 1.5 m track use 150 cm.
FisicaBitSerial.fijarFiltroUltrasonido: Smoothing: median of the last 3, 5 or 7 samples. It does not lower the sample rate; it adds a delay of 1, 2 or 3 samples. For uniform/accelerated motion: light. For collisions or free fall: none.
FisicaBitSerial.estadoUltrasonido: Sensor status in a few words, to show on the display: "OK 45cm" = measuring; "SIN ECO" = the sensor does not respond (check VCC: many HC-SR04 need 5 V; GND; and that there is an object within range); "ECHO ALTO" = the ECHO pin is stuck high (TRIG and ECHO swapped or module not powered).
FisicaBitSerial.fijarTemperaturaAireUltr: Air temperature used to compute the speed of sound (331.3 + 0.606·T m/s). At 20 °C it is 343.4 m/s; every 5 °C changes the distances by ≈1 %.
FisicaBitSerial.fijarFrecuenciaUltrasoni: Fixed sample rate in Hz (0 = automatic from the range). The HC-SR04 cycle limits the rate to ≈33 Hz. If you ask for more than the range allows, the echo of one measurement may contaminate the next one: use it with short ranges.
FisicaBitSerial.fijarRangoUltrasonido: Valid range: readings outside it are discarded and the last valid one is kept. The maximum also sets the range (echo timeout).
FisicaBitSerial.fijarSaltoMaximoUltrason: Step rejection: if a sample differs from the previous one by more than this value it is discarded (side reflections, someone walking across). 0 = disabled. For a cart at 1 m/s at 33 Hz the real step is 30 mm per sample: use 100 mm.
Maximum allowed step in mm (0 = disabled)
FisicaBitSerial.calibrarUltrasonido: Calibrates the sensor offset: place a flat surface at a known distance (for example 300 mm measured with a tape), run the block and the extension corrects all following readings. Takes ~1 s and shows ✓ or ✗.
FisicaBitSerial.calibrarUltrasonido|para: Real distance to the object in mm
FisicaBitSerial.medirDistanciaUltrasonid: Last raw distance (no filter, no offset) in the chosen unit; 0 if there was no echo. Shows the real noise of the sensor.
FisicaBitSerial.ecoUltrasonidoValido: True if the last sample had a valid echo (object within range and no rejected step).
FisicaBitSerial.frecuenciaRealUltrasonid: Actual sample rate of the sensor (Hz), measured over 1 second by triggering it as often as its cycle allows (≈33 Hz; less at long range or when the echo fails).
FisicaBitSerial.tiempoUltimoEcoUltrasoni: Instant (ms since power-up, 1 decimal) at which the sound hit the object in the last valid sample.
